name: Pulse Synth
description: Polyphonic virtual-analog synth: two oscillators with unison, sub and noise, a resonant multimode filter, two envelopes and an LFO.

name: Sampler
description: Sampled instruments: pianos, strings, winds, guitars, organs and voices.

name: Drum Kit
description: Synthesized drum machine with four kit characters, GM drum mapping.

name: Sample Kit
description: TightKit: a sampled drum kit (kick, snare, clap, hats, tom, conga, shaker).

name: Keys
description: Electric piano, drawbar organ and soft piano in one instrument.

name: Channel EQ
description: Five-band channel equalizer: low/high cut, two shelves and a sweepable mid.

name: Compressor
description: Stereo-linked compressor with soft knee and parallel mix.

name: Echo
description: Tempo-synced stereo / ping-pong echo with filtered feedback.

name: Space
description: Lush algorithmic reverb, from small rooms to endless washes.

name: Chorus
description: Stereo chorus with feedback, from subtle shimmer to seasick flange.

name: Drive
description: Saturation, clipping, fuzz and bitcrushing with a tone control.

name: Auto Filter
description: Resonant filter swept by a tempo-syncable LFO and an envelope follower.

name: Limiter
description: Transparent lookahead brickwall limiter (3 ms latency).

name: Stereo Width
description: Stereo width, balance, gain, polarity and mono utility.

name: Tremolo
description: Amplitude tremolo and auto-pan, free running or tempo-synced.
